caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a tall backrest. The chair has four legs, each turned and featuring a series of decorative, rounded elements. The legs are connected by horizontal stretchers for added stability, with the front stretcher also turned and detailed. The backrest is composed of five narrow vertical slats, each shaped and curved, with the outer two attaching to the turned uprights at each side. At the top, the backrest is adorned with a carved decorative panel featuring a symmetrical scrollwork design. The seat of the chair is upholstered with a brightly colored fabric that features an intricate pattern of interlocking hexagons in shades of red, blue, green, yellow, and tan. The wood of the chair appears to be dark brown, while the background is a plain, light beige color. The overall composition centers the chair in the frame with no other objects present.
title: Side Chair
